info.title: Video Agent API
info.description: Make videos from a prompt with Netlify Agent Runners and HyperFrames.

bearerAuth.description: API key: nva_<keyId>_<secret>, created in the web app.

cookieAuth.name: nf_jwt
cookieAuth.description: The web app session (Netlify Identity). State-changing requests must be same-origin.

planningAvailable.description: AI Gateway is available, so Plan it first is offered.

mcpOAuth.description: MCP clients can connect with OAuth (Sign in with Netlify) as well as API keys.

unread.description: Others' comments since you last read them

plan.description: The plan accepted before this version was made, if any.

incorporates.description: How many comments this version was asked to incorporate.

editable.description: Ready and keeps editing contract v1, so it can be edited in the browser.

mode.description: render_unchanged: an edit made in the browser, rendered as is (no agent authoring).

posterSources.description: Smaller poster images (480 and 960 px wide), best format first, ready for <picture><source>. Only for versions rendered with them.

clip.description: A short muted preview clip (480 px wide, a few seconds), best format first, ready for <video><source>. Use instead of the GIF when present.

lqip.description: A tiny blurred poster as a data URI, to show while the poster loads.

files.description: Signed URLs for the poster and preview GIF, once the version has files (30 to 60 minutes; 5 to 10 for private videos). Use links for a fresh one.

posterWebp.description: A 960px-wide WebP poster, for versions rendered with preview variants.

prompt.example: A 20-second launch video for our new webhooks feature

durationSec.description: Target length in seconds. Omit for Auto.

planId.description: A plan from POST /api/v1/plans; its brief is added to the run. Optional.

webhookUrl.description: HTTPS URL for video.ready / video.failed events (API keys only).

mediaIds.description: Library items (GET /api/v1/media) the agent should use: images, clips, fonts.
Library items (GET /api/v1/media) the agent should use: images, clips, fonts.

commentIds.description: Incorporate feedback: open comments on the version being revised (owner or admin). prompt is your note.

seq.description: For live=1: the checkpoint this snapshot is from

webhookSecret.description: Signs webhooks for videos created with this key. Shown once.

secret.description: Shown only when the webhook is created or rotated.

mediaIds.description: Library items to plan around. The planner sees the first few images; the video made from this plan uses them all.

briefRev.description: The briefRev you loaded; the save is refused if it changed (If-Match also works).

step.description: The agent's latest step, in its own words

steps.description: Agent steps so far (a count, not a percentage)

observedAt.description: When the run was last read (null: from stored rows)

stale.description: True when the run couldn't be read and this is the last known value

checkpoint.description: The latest milestone the run reported itself

newerVersion.description: A newer version exists: start from it, or render this draft as the next version

usedIn.description: Videos you can see that use it

urls.description: Signed for 10 minutes; null until the item is ready

uploaded.description: Part indexes already received (resume from here)

unreadCount.description: Others' comments on this video since you last read

x.description: 0–1 across the displayed video, letterboxing excluded

y.description: 0–1 down the displayed video, letterboxing excluded

planningCredits.description: Estimated AI Gateway credits for planning (Plan it first).

planningUnknown.description: Planning calls whose cost is unknown (errors, timeouts).

get.summary: Liveness and setup readiness (no secrets)
Public configuration for the sign-in screen

post.summary: Create a video from a prompt

get.summary: List videos, newest first
One video with its versions

patch.summary: Rename a video or make it private

delete.summary: Delete a video, its versions, files and public links

202.description: Deleted; files are removed in the background

post.summary: Revise: start the next version from a ready one
Try a failed, cancelled or timed-out version again
Stop a version in progress
Publish a version to a public link

delete.summary: Unpublish a version (its link stops working on the next request)

put.summary: Approve a version or request changes (null clears your verdict); never on your own version

get.summary: A short-lived link to play a ready version's composition in the sandboxed preview (live=1: a running version's latest snapshot)
Download a file: redirects to a signed URL valid for 5 to 10 minutes

put.summary: Admins: add a preview variant (or the placeholder, name lqip) to a ready version that doesn't have it yet

get.summary: Your API keys

post.summary: Create an API key (the secret is shown once)

get.summary: Your connected OAuth apps (404 when MCP OAuth is off)

delete.summary: Disconnect an OAuth app (its tokens stop working)

get.summary: Who you are
List users (admin)

patch.summary: Change a role, disable or enable a user (admin)

get.summary: Get your webhook (events on videos you own)

put.summary: Set your webhook URL (a signing secret is returned once, on create or rotate)

delete.summary: Remove your webhook (pending deliveries to it are dropped)

post.summary: Send a signed webhook.test event to your webhook now

get.summary: Get the team webhook (events on every video)

put.summary: Set the team webhook URL (a signing secret is returned once, on create or rotate)

delete.summary: Remove the team webhook (pending deliveries to it are dropped)

post.summary: Send a signed webhook.test event to the team webhook now
Start planning a video: a fast router decides whether a few questions would help

get.summary: A plan (yours)

patch.summary: Save your edits to the brief (send the briefRev you loaded)

post.summary: 0–6 multiple-choice questions about the video (empty when the prompt covers it)
Turn the answers into an editable brief

get.summary: Your credits this month: agent runs and planning (estimates)
Comments and approvals on your videos, newest first, with an unread count

post.summary: Mark notifications read (all, or up to a time)

get.summary: Live progress of the latest version's run: the agent's step, steps and credits so far

post.summary: Open your edit draft of a finished, editable version (creates it if you have none)

get.summary: One of your edit drafts

put.summary: Save the full list of edits as the next rev (rev must match the draft, for multi-tab safety)

delete.summary: Discard one of your edit drafts

post.summary: Render your draft as the next version, unchanged (the run checks and renders; it never redesigns)

get.summary: A short-lived link to play the draft's current rev in the sandboxed preview

post.summary: Upload one file up to 4 MB as the request body (images, SVG, fonts, short clips); bigger files use upload sessions

get.summary: The team's media library, newest first (plus your own uploads still being checked)

post.summary: Start an upload session for a file over 4 MB (declare its size and sha256; quota is reserved)

get.summary: An upload session: which parts arrived (to resume) and its status

delete.summary: Cancel an unfinished upload session (frees its parts and quota)

put.summary: Send one part (at most 4 MB) as the request body; x-part-sha256 guards against corruption

post.summary: Finish the upload: the file is assembled and checked in the background (poll the session or the item)

poster.description: Base64 JPEG poster for a clip

get.summary: One media item

delete.summary: Remove it from the library (uploader or admin); versions that used it keep it

get.summary: Comments on a video (optionally one version), oldest first, with your unread count

post.summary: Comment on a version, optionally pinned to a moment (timeSec) and a spot (x, y)
Mark this video's comments read (all, or up to a time)

patch.summary: Edit your comment, or resolve/reopen one (video owner or admin)

delete.summary: Delete your comment, or any comment on your video (owner or admin)

post.summary: Transfer videos to another Creator or Admin: some videos, or all of a person's (admin)

get.summary: Runs, queue, failures and credits (admin)

post.summary: Mark an unresolved start as failed and free its slot (admin)
Resume a queue paused because AI credits were unavailable (admin)
